subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: After real Microsoft Teams proof is supplied, should this PR become the canonical implementation instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867?
rationale: Both contributor branches implement the same fix and neither currently has sufficient real Teams proof; choosing the canonical contribution and handling the overlapping branch requires human ownership judgment.

options.title: Adopt this branch after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline without exporting a private adapter, then merge only after redacted live Teams or Bot Framework proof.

options.title: Adopt the older branch
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 if maintainers value its smaller diff, but require equivalent real Teams proof and updated current-main validation first.

options.title: Prepare a maintainer replacement
options.body: Pause both contributor branches and create a credited replacement if maintainers want transport-level proof and a consolidated minimal test shape before landing.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline without exporting a private adapter, then merge only after redacted live Teams or Bot Framework proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history and merged sibling sanitizer work most strongly connect this person to the outbound plugin boundary and canonical-fix selection.
